record.what_it_does: Plain is a B2B customer support platform (help desk / shared inbox with AI agent "Ari") built API-first on top of a GraphQL API.
record.auth_notes: The GraphQL API (core-api.uk.plain.com) is authenticated with a static Machine User API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer plainApiKey_xxx` (no OAuth flow for third-party API access). The separate official MCP server (mcp.plain.com) uses OAuth2 tied to a human user's session instead of API keys.
record.access_notes: Pricing starts at Foundation ($35/mo, billed yearly) with a 7-day free trial and no credit card required; API/Webhooks/Events are listed as plan features. There is no perpetual free tier, so ongoing programmatic access requires converting to a paid plan after the trial.
record.main_blocker: No perpetual free tier; production API/webhook access requires a paid subscription after the 7-day trial

evidence.quote: You authenticate with your existing Plain account, so the MCP server has the same permissions as your user. No API keys needed.
Foundation, Get support right from day one, $35/month
The Plain MCP server at `https://mcp.plain.com/mcp` lets tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor work with your support data directly.
Webhooks allow you to get notified about events happening in your Plain workspace.

record.open_questions: Exact feature availability per tier (Foundation/Horizon/Frontier) for API, Webhooks, and Events was not visible in pricing page text extraction, though all three are listed as Extensibility features — documentation confirms no tier restrictions on API access itself, only billing-related (trial vs. paid).
